newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Dec. 13:
WASHINGTON - Michael Ovitz, the powerful Hollywood agent who became Walt Disney's No. 2 executive, abruptly left the company after 16 months.
WASHINGTON - A federal jury found Fannie Mae, the District-based institution that finances housing, guilty of gender-based discrimination and retaliation.

TOKYO - Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's plan is being touted as the Japanese version of the "Big Bang" of 1986, when in one swoop British regulators cast off decades-old controls of London's huge financial markets.
